instruction: How many hours does the battery of ecobee SmartCamera last? Please answer as per its amazon reviews or questions/answers and and only trust information from its verified purchasers.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database mutation is allowed (goal only requires knowledge predicates plus task-completed). The amazon lookup APIs used (search_products, show_product_reviews, show_product_questions, show_product_question_answers) take no access token, so login is modeled via a nullary-style (logged-in amazon) predicate set by amazon-login rather than passing a token parameter to those actions; login is kept to follow the standard convention. The answer (battery hours) must be sourced only from verified purchasers, hence is_verified=true is passed to both the reviews and the question-answers lookups; the model requires reviews to be checked before the Q&A answer is accepted so both sources are consulted. At runtime the agent may need to page through results or inspect several questions; the single question object stands for the battery-related question found.
